project_info.theme: Father's Day retail offer for YSL
project_info.color_palette: Royal blue, black chrome, icy blue flowers, white

main_subject.detail: A tall vertical Father's Day poster on a royal blue background features a large black metallic YSL monogram decorated with blue hydrangea-like flowers. Top text reads 'YvesSaintLaurent BEAUTE', '12 - 21.06', 'HAPPY FATHER’S DAY', and 'CHẤT HƯƠNG DÀNH TẶNG NGƯỜI ĐÀN ÔNG ĐÍNH ĐẠC'. A rounded gift panel at the bottom says 'QUÀ TẶNG KHI MUA 100ML LIBRE EDP 10ML & TÚI ĐỰNG MỸ PHẨM NAM' and shows a mini perfume and a black pouch.
main_subject.style: Luxury seasonal retail poster, bold branded composition, premium holiday gift promotion

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality vertical seasonal retail poster for YSL. Centerpiece is a giant glossy black YSL monogram on a royal blue background, partially decorated with clusters of soft blue flowers. Include the exact text 'YvesSaintLaurent BEAUTE', '12 - 21.06', 'HAPPY FATHER’S DAY', 'CHẤT HƯƠNG DÀNH TẶNG NGƯỜI ĐÀN ÔNG ĐÍNH ĐẠC', and the bottom offer 'QUÀ TẶNG KHI MUA 100ML LIBRE EDP 10ML & TÚI ĐỰNG MỸ PHẨM NAM'. Add a rounded blue bottom panel containing a mini perfume bottle and a black pouch. Technical style: photoreal luxury retail-poster composite, crisp dramatic studio lighting, metallic highlights and saturated blue contrast, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
